import datetime

month_start = current_date.replace(day=1, hour=0, minute=0, second=0, microsecond=0)
last_month_start = (month_start - datetime.timedelta(days=1)).replace(day=1)
# Actually last month start: first day of previous month
last_month_start = (month_start - datetime.timedelta(days=1)).replace(day=1)
# We'll consider created_at >= last_month_start and < next month start
next_month_start = (month_start.replace(day=28) + datetime.timedelta(days=4)).replace(day=1)
# Simpler: filter by year-month

    dt = datetime.datetime.fromisoformat(dt_str)
